scripts.build: apt-get update && apt-get install -y wget gnupg && wget -q -O - https://dl-ssl.google.com/linux/linux_signing_key.pub | gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/google-chrome.gpg && echo 'deb [arch=amd64 signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/google-chrome.gpg] http://dl.google.com/linux/chrome/deb/ stable main' > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/google-chrome.list && apt-get update && apt-get install -y google-chrome-stable fonts-freefont-ttf libxss1 && ln -sf /usr/bin/google-chrome-stable /usr/bin/chrome && npm install
